subject: Aligning on GPU footprint & latency planning — proposed tech deep-dive
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finwise.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning on GPU footprint & latency planning — proposed tech deep-dive

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Great to hear more about FinWise's inference patterns (short transactional prompts + some 4k-context reporting use cases). Based on our conversation, the two items we should lock down next are: 

1) Throughput targets (reqs for peak concurrent requests / p95 latency objectives)
2) A tech deep-dive to validate model variants and projected GPU footprints for Dedicated.

Suggested next step: a 60-minute engineering session where we walk your infra/ML folks through our throughput profiling template and run rough capacity math. That will let us give a preliminary Dedicated sizing and a follow-up estimate for reserved pools + burst sizing.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Mon Jul 5, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Jul 6, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Jul 7, 09:30–10:30

If none of those work, happy to use a Calendly link or your scheduler. I attached a short throughput template that we use to capture request mixes / sequence lengths — filling that out ahead of the call will make the session much more concrete.

Agenda (60m):
- 5m: introductions & goals
- 15m: brief recap of FinWise workload characteristics (you)
- 30m: profiling template walkthrough + preliminary sizing
- 10m: next steps / action items (SOW, timeline, sandbox access)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: redwood_throughput_template.xlsx
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finwise.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@finwise.com>, FinWise Infra Team <infra@finwise.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning on GPU footprint & latency planning — proposed tech deep-dive

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. All sounds correct. We want to target ~500 concurrent short requests at p95 <= 350ms for the core transactional flow, and then separately support ad-hoc 4k-context report generation (lower QPS, higher memory).

Jul 6 at 14:00 PDT works for our ML lead (Maya) and one infra engineer. I'll loop Maya in directly when we confirm. I uploaded a first-pass CSV of our request-mix to our internal drive — I'll send access after I confirm with security.

Two quick asks before the call: 
- Can you include an example Dedicated configuration (GPU type, expected tokens/sec, expected memory per instance)?
- We'll need a high-level SOW outline to share with procurement so they understand billing cadence.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Engineering | FinWise
alex.turner@finwise.com | +1 (617) 555-9876
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Aligning on GPU footprint & latency planning — prep notes

Karthik / Steph —

I skimmed the template Karthik attached and prepped a one-pager we can bring to the call (SLA variants + rough GPU mappings). I also pulled a short list of model variants we typically recommend for FinWise-style workloads (2x small-context optims + 1 large-context quantized).

Action items before the meeting (I'll own these):
- Draft a preliminary Dedicated config table (GPU sku, vCPU, RAM, expected tokens/sec) — link in the related_links doc.
- Draft SOW_outline_v1.pdf with billing cadence and high-level milestones.

I'll cc those into our invite. Also: can you confirm whether FinWise will require any on-prem connectivity / VPC peering during evaluation? That affects how we size burst vs. reserved pools.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finwise.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning on GPU footprint & latency planning — proposed tech deep-dive

Alex —

Great — locking in Tue Jul 6, 14:00–15:00 PDT for the tech deep-dive. Invite sent (Zoom) — you should see it from my calendar.

Pre-call asks from our side: if you can provide the CSV or a quick sampling of request traces (even a small subset) that will speed the sizing exercise by ~20–30 minutes. If security needs a tighter channel, we can accept a permanent S3 link with presigned URLs or a secure share.

I'll bring Monica and Steph; Monica will present the config table and SOW sketch. We'll aim to leave with a draft Dedicated sizing and a proposed timeline for a 2-week evaluation.

Thanks again — looking forward to it.

Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments included in the thread: SOW_outline_v1.pdf
